name: Separate HeLaM derived nuclear-pool protein-group estimates

provenance.title: HeLaM protein groups ranked by estimated nuclear-pool copies per cell
provenance.derivation: Median Copy number (Master Data AU) multiplied by Average 1K (AL) + Average Ref (AN), for Mostly Nuclear or Nuclear and Cytosolic only. This extends the authors' compartment mass redistribution on article PDF pp.26-27 to copy counts; the shared molecular mass cancels. Actin-binding predictions are excluded to honor their cytoskeleton override.
provenance.not_a_direct_observation: The derived column is not supplied by the authors, not a count of molecules in a single nucleus, and not a universal human or G1 abundance ranking.
provenance.measured_fraction_meaning: Nuclear low-speed pellet contains intact/broken/partly lysed cells and membranes. Authors estimate ~60% nuclear protein and ~40% other membrane proteins. Fraction values have been normalized and protein-yield-weighted by the authors; do not apply 0.32/0.20/0.48 weighting again.
provenance.source_normalization: Whole-cell intensity is reconstructed from fractions weighted 0.32 nuclear, 0.20 organellar, 0.48 cytosolic. Absolute copies use proteomic ruler histone calibration, ploidy 3, six biological static maps. 200 g/L assumed total protein affects cellular concentration; no nuclear concentration is derived here.
provenance.uncertainty: Published upper/lower copy SD deltas and fraction SDs retained separately. They are not confidence intervals. No joint derived SD or rank confidence interval is computed; covariance and per-map whole-cell copy estimates are not present in this extracted table. Source reports a median 2.3-fold copy-number offset versus an independent PrEST data set using another HeLa strain.
provenance.coverage: Only authors nuclear and nuclear/cytosolic categories are ranked. Other classes remain in the all-groups table with null derived value/rank. This intentionally omits nuclear-envelope proteins classified as organellar, genuine multilocalized proteins, low-abundance undetected proteins, and other unresolved entries. Missing derived rank is not absence from the nucleus.
provenance.protein_groups: Keep each original protein-group row intact. Shared peptides and multiple isoforms/paralogs are retained in accession lists. Never expand a group by assigning its full abundance to each accession or gene.
provenance.gene_symbol_caution: Gene names and accession groups are preserved as supplied in 2016. Modern histone symbols differ. A single UniProt accession can represent identical products of several genes, so a source label such as HIST1H4A does not resolve abundance by genomic gene of origin.
provenance.localization_counterexample: VIM is Nuclear and Cytosolic in this fractionation classification, yet HPA26.0 reports Supported intermediate-filament localization only (https://www.proteinatlas.org/ENSG00000026025-VIM/subcellular). The derived rank is a study-specific model output, not per-protein validation of an intranuclear pool. Retain this conflict and corroborate localization before populating a BioSim compartment.
provenance.source_values: Extracted from published XLSX cached cells with Python stdlib ZIP/XML; original workbooks not changed or recalculated.

biological_context.cell_cycle_state: Standard-culture static maps, not synchronized or sorted for G1
biological_context.normal_diploid_G1_applicability: Not established; do not rescale automatically to a normal diploid G1 nucleus

provenance.aggregation_caution: The derivative multiplies a source median whole-cell copy estimate by a source mean reassigned compartment fraction. This product is not necessarily the mean of paired replicate nuclear-copy estimates; rank uncertainty is not estimated.
provenance.output_units: Model-estimated protein-group nuclear-pool copies per source-study cell, under the stated allocation assumptions
